# 1419 — GuardDuty findings -> incident events

Board: https://maestromojo.com/workspaces/#/board/11?item=1419
Stage at claim: planned -> building (maestro-auto batch with #1417, #1418)

## Approved scope (user decision at the gate, 2026-08-06)

Sibling SNS receiver at POST /api/aws/guardduty/sns/finding with its own topic
allowlist, a GuardDutyFinding model + migration, and normalization into incident
Events.

**Approved severity policy**: a GuardDuty High/Critical finding must NOT
auto-open an incident. Map every band below INCIDENT_LEVEL_THRESHOLD (7);
incidents come only from an opt-in RuleSet, matching what #1207 chose for
CloudWatch (level=4 if ALARM else 2). Rationale: `use_catchall=False` does NOT
contain a level-8 event — the `elif created and LLM_API_KEY:` branch in
event.publish() is not guarded by dispatch_handlers, triage_new_incidents sweeps
every status="new" incident, and a new incident with source_ip stamps the address
'medium' in GeoLocatedIP. Turning on the receiver ships audit, not automation.

Also required (from the challenge): an `opening_event` FK so `model_id` rotates
per occurrence, and a per-occurrence dispatch idempotency prefix.

The full plan, challenge dispositions and contracts live on the board item.
